title: 第27章 第四道引灵纹路
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
铁背犀的内丹爆炸在沼泽边缘留下了一个数丈宽的大坑。

    坑底的泥水还在冒着泡，浑浊的水面上浮着一层暗紫色的毒雾残余，混着腐烂的水草和碎鳞片，散发出一股刺鼻的焦臭味。

    苏荇蹲在坑边，用观火镜照着坑底一块巴掌大的暗灰色晶体。

    晶体表面布满了细密的裂纹，每一条裂纹深处都透出极微弱的暗紫色光芒——那是铁背犀内丹被念毒侵蚀后留下的残留物。

    “内丹碎片还在往外释放灵力波动，频率和银叶花的灵纹几乎完全一致。”

    她把观火镜递给林尘。

    “你自己看——铁背犀活着的时候是金丹巅峰，内丹的灵力密度远高于普通金丹期妖兽。这块碎片虽然被念毒腐蚀过，但核心的灵纹结构没有完全破坏。如果能提取出来，可以用来强化锁灵阵的效果。”

    林尘接过观火镜照了一下，碎片内部的灵纹确实还在缓慢流转，每七息波动一次，和铁背犀生前护体灵力的波动频率完全一致。

    系统忽然弹出一道提示，面板悬浮在眼前。

    “检测到铁背犀内丹碎片残留灵力波动频率与锁灵阵引灵纹路高度兼容。建议将内丹碎片研磨成粉末，混入清心草汁后绘制锁灵阵外围第四道引灵纹路。升级后的锁灵阵可将目标灵力锁定时间从三息延长至五息，同时降低符阵激活时的灵力波动幅度，使目标更难察觉。”

    林尘把系统提示的内容转述给苏荇。

    “五息？比现在的三息多了将近一倍。”

    苏荇从坑底捡起那块内丹碎片，用银叶花叶子包好放进背包。

    “走，回炼丹室。今晚先把紫鳞解毒丹炼出来，然后试试能不能把这块碎片研磨成粉混入符阵。如果能成功升级锁灵阵，去火毒宗的时候多一张底牌——二长老是金丹巅峰，修为和铁背犀同级。锁灵阵能定住铁背犀一瞬，对二长老应该也有效。”

    两人沿着后山小路退回炼丹室。

    苏荇把补丁青铜炉放在地火口上，将紫鳞解毒丹的药材按配比备好——清心草多加一株，银叶花多加半朵，蛇涎果干片作为第二道缓冲，紫鳞果核一枚。

    林尘在炉底重新画了一遍御灵符阵，混沌灵力顺着指尖渗入符阵纹路，整个符阵亮起淡金色的微光。

    “入炉顺序照沈谷主改过的方案——先入紫鳞果核，后入清心草，银叶花置中缓冲。火候控制在五成炉火，全程稳定。”

    苏荇把药材按顺序放进炉内，盖上炉盖。

    观火镜里，紫鳞果核的十二道鳞片灵纹在灵火中缓缓展开。

    清心草的木属性灵纹紧随其后进入融合区，银叶花的水属性缓冲层在木火之间铺开。

    第十息，淡金色光晕在炉内铺开。

    第十二息达到峰值，第十三息前收火。

    三枚紫鳞解毒丹静静躺在炉底，丹纹清晰，每一枚表面都覆盖着一层极淡的鳞片状光晕。

    “成了。这炉比上一炉更稳——你的灵纹感知突破到第三层之后，控火的精度确实不一样了。”
content_en:
The iron-backed rhino's inner elixir exploded, leaving a large crater several feet wide at the edge of the swamp.

    The muddy water at the bottom of the pit was still bubbling, and there was a layer of dark purple poisonous mist floating on the turbid water, mixed with rotten water plants and broken scales, giving off a pungent burnt smell.

    Su Yun squatted by the pit and used a fire-viewing mirror to shine on a palm-sized dark gray crystal at the bottom of the pit.

    The surface of the crystal is covered with fine cracks, and a very weak dark purple light shines from the depth of each crack - that is the residue left after the iron-backed rhinoceros inner alchemy has been eroded by thought poison.

    "The inner elixir fragments are still releasing spiritual power fluctuations, and the frequency is almost exactly the same as the silver leaf flower's spiritual patterns."

    She handed the fire viewing mirror to Lin Chen.

    "See for yourself - the iron-backed rhinoceros was at the peak of the golden elixir when it was alive, and the spiritual power density of the inner elixir was much higher than that of ordinary golden elixir stage monsters. Although this fragment has been corroded by thought poison, the core spiritual pattern structure has not been completely destroyed. If it can be extracted, it can be used to strengthen the effect of the spirit locking array."

    Lin Chen took the fire-viewing mirror and took a look at it. The spiritual patterns inside the fragment were indeed still flowing slowly, fluctuating every seven breaths, which was exactly the same frequency as the fluctuation frequency of the iron-backed rhino's body-protecting spiritual power during his lifetime.

    The system suddenly popped up a prompt, and the panel floated in front of you.

    "It has been detected that the residual spiritual power fluctuation frequency of the iron-backed rhinoceros inner alchemy fragment is highly compatible with the spirit-guiding patterns of the spirit-locking array. It is recommended to grind the inner-alchemy fragments into powder, mix it with Qingxin grass juice, and then draw the fourth spirit-guiding pattern on the periphery of the spirit-locking array. The upgraded spirit-locking array can extend the locking time of the target's spiritual power from three breaths to five breaths, and at the same time reduce the range of spiritual power fluctuations when the array is activated, making it more difficult for the target to detect."

    Lin Chen relayed the contents of the system prompts to Su Yun.

    "Five breaths? Nearly twice as much as the current three breaths."

    Su Yun picked up the inner elixir fragment from the bottom of the pit, wrapped it in silver leaf flower leaves and put it in her backpack.

    "Let's go back to the alchemy room. Let's refine the Purple Scale Antidote Pill tonight, and then try to grind the fragments into powder and mix it into the talisman array. If you can successfully upgrade the Soul Locking Array, you will have an extra trump card when you go to the Fire Poison Sect - the second elder is at the peak of the Golden Elixir, and his cultivation level is at the same level as the Iron-backed Rhinoceros. The Spirit-locking Array can immobilize the Iron-backed Rhinoceros for a moment, and it should also be effective against the second elder."

    The two of them returned to the alchemy room along the back mountain path.

    Su Yun placed the patched bronze stove on the ground fire, and prepared the ingredients for the Purple Scale Detoxification Pill according to the proportions - add one more Qingxincao, half an extra Silver Leaf Flower, dried snake saliva fruit slices as the second buffer, and one Purple Scale Fruit Core.

    Lin Chen drew the spirit-controlling talisman array again on the bottom of the furnace. The chaotic spiritual energy seeped into the talisman array lines along his fingertips, and the entire talisman array shimmered with light gold.

    "The order of entering the furnace follows Master Shen Gu's modified plan - put the purple-scale fruit core first, then put the pure grass, and put the silver-leaf flower in the middle as a buffer. The heat is controlled at 50% of the furnace fire, and the whole process is stable."

    Su Yun put the medicinal materials into the furnace in order and closed the furnace lid.

    In the fire-viewing mirror, the twelve scale spiritual patterns on the purple-scale fruit core slowly unfolded in the spiritual fire.

    The wood-attribute spirit pattern of Qingxincao then entered the fusion zone, and the water-attribute buffer layer of Silverleaf Flower was spread between the wood fire.

    On the tenth breath, a pale golden halo spread in the furnace.

    It reaches its peak at the twelfth breath, and the fire is reduced before the thirteenth breath.

    Three purple-scale detoxification pills lay quietly at the bottom of the furnace. The pill patterns were clear, and the surface of each one was covered with a very light scaly halo.

    "It's done. This furnace is more stable than the last furnace - after your spiritual pattern perception breaks through to the third level, the accuracy of fire control is indeed different."
